summary.scanMethod: Original repository tools/scan-firmware-games.py, scans every offset for v1/v2/v4/v36 with mask 0 and 165; validates entries, section ordering, variable size, resource total. Max 64MiB/member. No vendor executable run.
limitations: No signature in raw files does not rule out compressed/encoded/custom game data.
Woodi OTO InstallShield CAB files not recursively unpacked, but firmware SB and resource.bin are separate ZIP members and scanned.
Host updaters were read as static PE files only; no unsafe driver or vendor program execution.
GVM/SGS short substring coincidences inside font glyph bytes are not counted as engine evidence.
